# Loan exports

One JSON object per line, one file per month.
branch "Eastgate" and "Eastgate Annex" are separate branches.
overdue is true when the item came back late (or is still out past its due date).

turns.prompt: How many overdue loans did the Eastgate branch have from March through August?
